scope.summary: Add EU statutory rulepack jurisdiction support and enforce per-jurisdiction official source-row provenance for payroll rulepack manifests.
explicit_non_claims: No filing, disbursement, production close, GA readiness, cloud deployment, secrets, or Release Please

facets.F1_correctness: Manifest construction now dispatches official source URL allowlists by PayrollRulepackJurisdiction and adds EuropeanUnion support while preserving existing US/KR behavior.
facets.F2_tests: Focused rulepack_manifest test plus full oya-payroll-run-domain test suite passed; adversarial source-row and overclaim cases are covered.
facets.F3_maintainability: The implementation is a small private validation seam: jurisdiction enum variant, URL-prefix constants, and a private build_rulepack_source parameter.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing US/KR manifest API shape is unchanged; successful manifests continue to emit false capability flags.
facets.F5_security: URLs must be HTTPS, jurisdiction allowlisted, no whitespace/control, no traversal, and no backslash; evidence refs keep existing secret-token substring rejection.
facets.F6_privacy: Source-row identifiers/evidence remain classified INTERNAL_ONLY while official URLs and source_count are public projections.
facets.F7_operability: Failures are typed PayrollDomainError variants and remain pure domain validation without network, filing, deployment, or secret access.
facets.F8_performance: The validation path is O(source rows * prefix count) over small static prefix lists and allocates only the output source vector.
facets.F9_compliance: The seam records provenance rows for KR/US/EU rulepack source material without asserting statutory correctness or filing readiness.
facets.F10_reversibility: The change is isolated to one domain crate and can be reverted without data migration.
facets.F11_observability: Per-row source_ref/evidence_ref/digest/retrieved_at fields remain available for downstream audit-chain evidence.
facets.F13_migration: No storage schema, API, generated face, or deployment migration is introduced.
facets.A1_naming_adherence: Branch, evidence, and task identifiers use payroll-stat-source-pack naming and card t_3681ab1f.
facets.A2_documentation_adherence: No docs are edited; evidence JSON carries explicit non-claims and verification links.
facets.A3_structure_adherence: Domain logic stays in oya-payroll-run-domain with tests in the existing rulepack_manifest test target.
facets.A4_architecture_adherence: Pure domain validation remains side-effect-free and does not attach calculation, filing, disbursement, or cloud deployment rails.
facets.A5_dependency_adherence: No dependencies or workspace members are added.
facets.A6_schema_adherence: No schema files are changed; manifest schema_version remains 1.
facets.A7_algorithm_adherence: Jurisdiction selection is an exhaustive enum match with fail-closed URL rejection.

known_gaps: cargo fmt --package oya-payroll-run-domain --check was also attempted and failed on pre-existing formatting drift in unchanged package files; no formatting-only changes were included in this scoped lane.
GitHub oya-ci-required and branch-protection review remain external PR governance gates after opening the PR.
